name: Harvester
description: The Winterworks Harvester: a big, gentle prehistoric herbivore with a huge hammerhead-shark-like head, small flat dot eyes at the ends of the hammer, a broad nose, a shovel mouth that hides its cropping teeth until it opens, a scaly mustard-yellow body on four thick legs with a dark green plated back, square scutes down the spine and a banded tail, short mossy fringes. Vanilla Minecraft mob style: chunky boxes, flat dot eyes, a small palette, clean scale rows. Saddle and saddlebag chests are separate bones the game shows or hides. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
